executive_summary: The AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am sets up as a premium ball-striker's tournament where approach play and scrambling around poa annua greens will separate contenders from pretenders. With bombers holding minimal advantage on the 6,972-yard layout, precise iron play becomes paramount to reaching the typical -17 winning score. Scottie Scheffler's +375 odds appear justified given his elite approach play metrics, while the three-course rotation and potential weather disruptions create opportunities for savvy scramblers to outperform their betting lines.

insights.title: Scheffler Deserves Favorite Status
insights.insight: At +375, Scheffler's odds reflect his elite strokes gained approach numbers and proven ability on poa annua surfaces. His scrambling prowess gives him multiple ways to score.

insights.title: Length Matters Less Here
insights.insight: With bombers advantage rated as low, the 6,972-yard Pebble Beach setup neutralizes big hitters. Focus on precision over power this week.

insights.title: Poa Putting Specialists Shine
insights.insight: Poa annua greens with their characteristic bumps favor players experienced on this grass type. West Coast natives and frequent California players hold edges.

insights.title: Three-Course Chaos Creates Value
insights.insight: The rotation format through three different layouts rewards versatile players who adapt quickly. Look for consistent ball-strikers over streaky putters.

insights.title: Weather Wild Card Factor
insights.insight: Brutal weather conditions historically separate field dramatically at Pebble Beach. Players with links experience and mental toughness gain significant advantages.

insights.title: Approach Play Premium Pricing
insights.insight: Strokes gained approach leaders deserve extra attention given course demands. Iron precision into small greens becomes the primary scoring differentiator.

insights.title: Scrambling Saves Rounds
insights.insight: With poa greens creating unpredictable bounces, scrambling ability becomes crucial for maintaining momentum through difficult stretches.

insights.title: Local Knowledge Advantage
insights.insight: California-based players and those with extensive Pebble Beach experience understand nuances of coastal conditions and poa surfaces better than field average.
